note:
AI will not come for your bullshit job.

The current frontier LLM models (what's called "AI" in common discourse) are force multipliers. They understand problems deeply, they can carry out complex, high level tasks at speeds that are orders of magnitude faster than even the best people.

Any task that adds value, that benefits from it being done at orders of magnitude cheaper, is at risk of being replaced by AI. When there's real economic value to doing a task that can be done for orders of magnitude more economically, it will be replaced.

All other jobs are safe precisely because they're not about economic productivity. This is a "Doormans fallacy", of sorts. If your job's value is actually opening doors, it will be automated away. If your job is to provide a signal of wealth or status, then it's completely safe from AI, at least in the short term, precisely because it's not about economic value.

If 30% of the USA's, European, Canadian, other other's, economy is a Graeber-like bullshit job, then those 30% jobs are completely safe. If your job as a middle manager is padding out a VP's business fiefdom, your job is safe. If your job is creating art whose value is judged, accepted and promoted by a small cabal of oligarchs that are gate keepers of "taste", your job is safe. If your job is to provide credentials to the children of middle to upper class population, don't worry, your job is safe. If your job was to "create value for your clients" but was really "create the illusion of legitimacy", then your job is safe.

If your job is toiling to feed the world, rejoice, because your job is about to be replaced by something orders of magnitude more efficient. If your job is illuminate the secrets of computation, mathematics or the universe, rejoice, because you're about to be replaced by something that's orders of magnitude more efficient. If your job is to heal the sick, rejoice, because you're about to be replaced by something that will save trillions.

If your job is to make art that resonates with people, rejoice, because you're about to be replaced with something that will understand the human condition in profound and subtle ways, tailored to each individuals experience, in a way that you would only ever be able to crudely broach.

If you're about to be replaced, rejoice because the reason you'll be replaced will be because what you've been doing had value and the coming revolution will continue to add value at a pace that would be impossible otherwise. If you're not about to be replaced, rejoice, because you can continue to do what you've been doing because it had little economic value to begin with.
